# Reports

**What:** dated HTML artifacts generated by agents (or apps) and browsed on
`/reports`. A **report type** is the 5th git building block —
`reports/<name>/report.yaml` declares what a class of reports is; the
instances live in Postgres with the identity `type/YYYY-MM-DD[/HH-MM]`.

**Lives in:** `reports/<name>/report.yaml` (the declaration, change-loop
managed on `coder/report-<name>`) + the `reports` table (the artifacts).

## The declaration

```yaml
name: daily-news
description: Morning digest of gathered news, grouped by topic.
icon: 📰
generator: app:news       # WHO may write instances (see ACL below)
cadence: daily            # daily | intraday | adhoc
retention_days: 365       # 0 = keep forever; pruned by the dispatcher
```

- **`generator` is the write ACL** for machine callers: an agent name (a run
  key scoped to that agent) or an app key's principal name (`app:<name>`).
  Admin sessions may always write. Undeclared or broken types reject saves
  with a 422.
- **Cadence is validated**: daily refuses a time component, intraday requires
  `HH-MM`, adhoc takes either. Saving the same identity again REPLACES the
  artifact — re-runs are safe.
- ReportTypes do **not** schedule anything: the generator's entrypoints/jobs
  fire whatever run produces the report.

## Authoring (agents: use the `reports` skill)

- Send a **fragment** (no html/head/style); the viewer wraps it in the
  report-kit shell at render time, so old reports restyle as the kit evolves.
- **Only report-kit markup survives**: the platform sanitizes on ingest (nh3
  allow-list) — unknown classes, styles, scripts, event handlers, and
  url() paints are stripped. The blessed vocabulary is `rk-*` (see the
  ReportKit stories in Storybook — every class has one; missing element →
  add it to `packages/ui/src/report-kit.css` + a story FIRST).
- **Charts are server-rendered SVG** (`POST /api/report-kit/chart`): reports
  carry no JavaScript — the viewer iframe is sandboxed script-free — and the
  SVG uses `var(--ds-chart-*)`, so charts are theme-aware.

## Viewing

`/reports` → type grid → month calendar per type → sandboxed viewer
(prev/next, intraday time chips, provenance link to the generating run).

## Security posture

Report HTML is agent-generated from untrusted inputs. Three layers: nh3
allow-list at ingest, a script-free sandboxed iframe with a deny-all CSP at
render, and the generator ACL on writes.
